question: Can tardigrades survive in outer space?
short_answer: Yes, tardigrades (water bears) can enter a dehydrated state called cryptobiosis, allowing them to survive complete exposure to outer space vacuum, extreme radiation, and temperatures near absolute zero.
full_explanation: During the 2007 European TARDIS experiment aboard FOTON-M3, desiccated tardigrades were exposed to space vacuum and solar UV rays for 10 days. Upon rehydration on Earth, many survived and reproduced normally.
